snapshot.title: Time Jump: 10:00 — Incident Escalation

fields.narration: Narrative Clock: 10:00. The problem has spread to multiple systems and public channels. The Early Vote Center line is now 45 people long. The spoofed notice has been shared on 12 local Facebook groups. The hotline has received 137 calls in 30 minutes. The IT team has confirmed the account compromise, but no one has declared an incident level yet. Operations are operating in manual mode on unverified data.

The Election Operations Center remains active but under strain.
